english.title: To deceive use a forged / altered / revoked / suspended certificate / licence approval / permission / exemption
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive, used

(A)_[a certificate,]_
(B)_[a licence,]_
(C)_[an approval,]_
(D)_[a permission,]_
(E)_[an exemption,]_
(F)_[a document,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY CERTIFICATE ETC..), issued by or under

(G)_[the Air Navigation Order 2009]_
(H)_[an EASA Regulation]_
(I)_[EU-OPS]_

(J)_[which had been forged]_
(K)_[which had been altered]_
(L)_[which had been revoked]_
(M)_[which had been suspended]_
(N)_[to which you were not entitled]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 231(1)(a), 241(7) of, and Part C of Schedule 13 to, the Air Navigation Order 2009.
